name: TDengine Subscription
description:
TMQ data source is a reader-only data source for TDengine.

## Protocols

- **ws**: websocket protocol with plain HTTP connection.
- **wss**: websocket protocol with TLS http connection.

Without protocol settings, TMQ will use native connection.

## Subject

TMQ data source could subscribe data from a database or
a specified table with fully "database.name" format.

protocol.description: Choose a protocol scheme for websocket connection, leave it empty for native connection

host.description: TDengine fqdn. Leave it empty if use server localhost(relative to taosX server).

port.description: TDengine connection port, leave it empty if use default port.

username.description: TDengine username. The default is root.

password.description: TDengine password. The default is taosdata.

subject.description: Database name, database.table name or topic name is all available.

params.name: token
params.description: Copy the token from TDcloud admin panel.

params.name: group.id
params.description: A consumer group id. One group id shares consume offsets globally.

params.name: client.id
params.description: Consumer client id to distinguish from individual clients.

params.name: use.topic.name
params.description:
Use specific topic name for selected database or database.name,
which does not work if the subject is direct topic name.

params.name: timeout
params.description:
A timeout for polling data from the topic.

The input value should be one of:

- `never`: means waiting for valid message without timeout.
- A duration string like `5s`, `1m` etc.
